title: Favorite clarinetists: Tony Parenti and Harry Shields
summary: Brownlee praises Tony Parenti's pit work and use of one clarinet, and Shields's harmonic sense and how players once worked without reading.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
